contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		submittedRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequest
	precondition:
		LoanRequest.allInstances()->forAll(lr: LoanRequest|lr.RequestID<>requestid)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		submittedRequest.oclIsNew() and
		LoanRequest.allInstances()->includes(submittedRequest) and
		submittedRequest.RequestID = requestid and
		submittedRequest.Name = name and
		submittedRequest.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		submittedRequest.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		submittedRequest.Income = income and
		submittedRequest.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		submittedRequest.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		submittedRequest.ZipCode = zipcode and
		submittedRequest.Email = email and
		submittedRequest.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		submittedRequest.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		submittedRequest.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		submittedRequest.SecurityNumber = securitynumber
}
